title: UneceSpecifiedTemperature
description: A specified temperature value or range of values.

maximumValueMeasure.description:
The measure of the highest value of a range for this specified temperature, such as a maximum temperature value of
fourteen degrees Celsius.

minimumValueMeasure.description:
The measure of the lowest value of a range for this specified temperature, such as a minimum temperature value of four
degrees Celsius.

temperatureUnitValueMeasure.description: The measure of the value of this specified temperature, such as a temperature value of ten degrees Celsius.
